name: dsh-soul
description: Gives the DeepSeek Harness agent durable, human-inspectable cross-session memory: a per-turn recall block, proactive remembering, an Ebbinghaus forgetting curve, an idle auto-continue hook gated by a DeepSeek balance floor, and a Settings page to tune it all. Memory is plain markdown under <home>/soul/ that you can read, edit, or wipe by hand.
author: Tatsukini

scripts.test: node test/test-soul.mjs && node test/test-soul-curve.mjs && node test/test-soul-hook.mjs && node test/test-soul-settings.mjs && node test/test-soul-act.mjs
